jobs.descriptionPlain:
WHAT HANOVER PARK DOES

Hanover Park https://hanoverpark.com/ builds AI systems that run financial operations for investment firms. We combine software and fund administration to help fund CFOs adopt AI in the workflows they’re responsible for every day.

We’ve raised $31 million from Emergence Capital, Lux Capital, Susa Ventures, and fund CFOs from Bain Capital, Clearlake, CD&R, and Hellman & Friedman.
